Maya (AE): Hey team — NovaRetail wants a concrete plan for their weird traffic shape: lots of short sessions (1–3s), repeated microbursts up to ~250 qps for 20–45s, then long idle. They care about tail latency, cost for bursty traffic, and KMS for keys. Can SE + Eng propose a test harness + config and a quick cost/back-of-envelope for burst vs reserved?
Sam (SE): Thanks — yep that pattern is common. Quick q's: which model family are they testing (Llama2-13B? open-vicuna?), avg prompt ~120 tokens, response ~80 tokens? Also do they need streaming?
Maya (AE): They said "open-13b-ish", avg total tokens ~200, streaming ok but not required. They asked if we can show p50/p95/p99 and error rates for microbursts, and also a priming run to warm prefix cache.
Sam (SE): Plan proposal: 1) priming phase: 5 min continuous warmup at ~50 qps to populate prefix/KV cache 2) burst sweep: 5x microbursts at [50, 100, 150, 200, 250] qps each 45s with 3m idle between 3) sustained baseline: 10m at target sustained qps (if any). We'll capture p50/p95/p99, GPU utilization, token/sec, and error pct.
Sam (SE): Lightweight harness command we use for these runs (adaptable):
```bash
./bench_client --model open-13b-q4f32 --seq 200 --concurrency 12 \\\n  --burst-profile "45s@250qps,180s@0qps" --repeat 5 --out metrics.json
```
Sam (SE): If they prefer open tools, we can also run a wrk-like probe for HTTP endpoints:
```bash
w rk -t12 -c300 -d45s -s ./scripts/microburst.lua --latency http://redwood/api/v1/generate
```
Devon (Eng): For runtime config I'd recommend: prefix_cache.enabled=true, prefix_cache.size=200MB, batch_max_tokens=2048, batch_time_ms=8, async_kv_prefetch=true. For microbursts set autoscale.response_burst=enabled with cool-down 120s. If they're on Dedicated/Private, reserve a 2x burst buffer for short term.
Devon (Eng): Example config snippet:
```json
{"runtime": {"prefix_cache": {"enabled": true, "size_mb": 200}, "batch": {"max_tokens": 2048, "time_ms": 8}}}
```
Priya (Security): KMS note: NovaRetail asked about HSM-backed keys and per-tenant rotation. Private or Dedicated supports HSM integration (YubiHSM / cloud KMS backed HSM). We also need to confirm IP allowlist for load generator and whether they require offline key wrapping. I can draft the security Q answers once they confirm deployment mode.
Maya (AE): Pricing question from Tom: what is incremental cost for bursty usage vs our usual per-token? Can you give a quick delta?
Sam (SE): Quick back-of-envelope: main drivers are GPU time (tokens/sec) and reserved vs burst capacity. Example: for open-13b-q4 variant on hosted, baseline per-1k tokens = $0.12 (example). For bursty patterns with reserved capacity hit, effective cost might be ~1.2–1.6x because of idle inefficiency and warmup. If they commit to a small Dedicated pool to cover steady + burst buffer, delta drops to ~1.05–1.2x. I'll put numbers in a follow-up with exact cluster sizes.
Tom (Prospect): We can give you two 2-hour windows this week to run the tests. Also want to see how quick cold <-> warm transitions are.
Sam (SE): Perfect — we'll run a scripted sequence: cold-start check (start no priming, run 45s @150 qps), then primed run (do 5m warm then same burst). That will show delta for cold vs primed.
Devon (Eng): Sample quick-results from a recent internal run on open-13b-q4 (for reference):
"burst 30s @250 qps: p50=78ms, p95=210ms, p99=410ms, error=0.2%, avg GPU util=74%"
Devon (Eng): For cold-start sample (no priming): p95 jumped to ~520ms and error ~1.8% for the first burst. So priming helps a lot for their pattern.
Maya (AE): Can we include a short blurb about recommended contract shape (month-to-month + add-on burst reserve vs small monthly reserved pool)? I'll draft and Sam/Finance adjust pricing numbers.
Sam (SE): Yes — recommend: small Reserved pool to cover steady + 25% headroom, plus on-demand burst credits for occasional 2–5x surges. We'll give a cost model: Reserved saves ~30% on steady usage, burst credits billed at slightly higher rate.
Priya (Security): Also flag: if they require FedRAMP-ish controls we need Private deploy + audit retention 13 months; that affects cost and timeline.
Tom (Prospect): Thanks — schedule us for Wednesday 10am PST. Want results emailed and a short runbook we can share with infra folks.
Maya (AE): Got it — booking Wed 10am PST. Sam/Devon, can you confirm harness and I'll send invite + pre-run checklist to Tom?
Sam (SE): Confirmed. I'll attach the harness + a minimal runbook after this thread.
